title: The explicit composition series of A₄: A₄ ▷ V₄ ▷ 1 with identified factors

problemStatement.formal: Exhibit the composition series A₄ ▷ V₄ ▷ {e} in Lean with A₄/V₄ ≅ ℤ/3ℤ and V₄ ≅ (ℤ/2ℤ)² identified.
problemStatement.plain: The parent proves A₄ solvable indirectly. This asks to exhibit A₄'s classical composition series explicitly with both composition factors identified with their standard models.
whyMatters: Turns an indirect solvability proof into the textbook composition series with named abelian layers.
Shows the derived series and composition series of A₄ coincide (V₄ = [A₄,A₄]).

open: Contrast with A₅ (simple, only series A₅ ▷ 1).
knownResults.goal: Explicit composition series with identified factors. ACHIEVED (0-axiom).

currentState.focus: Verified the previously-UNVERIFIED file (build host was down at #30747) and created its own gallery entry.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: AbelRuffiniOQ04OQ02OQ02OQ01.lean (136 lines, 11 theorems, 0 axioms) exhibits A₄'s composition series A₄ ▷ V₄ ▷ 1 with both factors identified (A₄/V₄ ≅ ℤ/3ℤ, V₄ ≅ (ℤ/2ℤ)²). File existed (added UNVERIFIED in #30747 when build host was down, repaired in #30783) but had no gallery entry of its own; this session verified it (lake env lean, 0-axiom) and created the gallery entry.
insights: Prime-order quotient ⟹ cyclic ⟹ ℤ/nℤ via isCyclic_of_prime_card + mulEquivOfPrimeCardEq (no generator needed).
Order-4 exponent-2 ⟹ Klein four ⟹ (ℤ/2ℤ)² via IsKleinFour.nonempty_mulEquiv (no element matching).
Mathlib's alternatingGroup.kleinFour gives V₄ ◁ A₄ with normality, card, IsKleinFour, and = commutator all packaged.
The file was orphaned as an additionalFile of sibling abel-ruffini-oq-04-oq-02-oq-01; its parent open question warranted a dedicated entry.
